assumptions.statement: All submitted spatial layers use the repository's provisional rough boundaries; they are for generation, visualization and intake self-check only, not official redline, approval or precise-area basis.
assumptions.impact: When official polygons arrive, site boundary, key areas, land use, buildings, roads, green space, public space, phasing and all metrics must be recalculated as a whole.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Official boundary/key-area GeoJSON or cleared CAD/GIS released by the organizer.

assumptions.statement: Regulatory-plan controls (FAR, height, density, green ratio, setbacks, road redlines), ownership, and engineering conditions are not in the cleared site package.
assumptions.impact: All intensity, height, demolition/renovation, alignment and capacity statements are directional concepts pending official conditions; no inferred values are presented as approved controls.

assumptions.statement: Utility lines, fire access, flood control, stormwater and sponge-city metrics are missing from public materials.
assumptions.impact: Municipal and new-infrastructure proposals remain directional concepts; no capacity or load conclusions are made.

assumptions.statement: Heritage protection scopes (e.g., Qinghuayuan station heritage site) and ecological blue lines (Qinghe, Xiaoyuehe) have no GIS layers in the site package.
assumptions.impact: Culture nodes and waterfront interfaces are designed only as conceptual surroundings; they must not touch protected structures, buffer zones or blue lines, and must be rechecked with official layers.
